questions.prompt: Which pitfall matters when applying “Model and dataset provenance”?
options: Change several unrelated settings at once and infer which change fixed the result.
Treat successful imports as proof that the full model and evaluation pipeline are correct.

Do not hide all exceptions or assume bitwise equality across devices and package versions.
